changes.title: Dodge
items: Your blink now has two charges: dodge twice in a row, and they come back one at a time
Animals no longer miss you just because you're walking away: they close in as they wind up and strike where you're going, so blink as they lunge
Shooters, lobbers and charging animals aim where you're heading, so change direction or blink to slip their shots
Packs of wolves, foxes, martens and bats run ahead to cut off your retreat
Only one animal strikes at you at a time, with a short gap between strikes, so a well-timed blink always has an answer
Add ?dodge=a,b,c (or ?dodge=0) to the link to compare the new fighting with the old

changes.title: Bigger creatures
items: Creatures are half again as big, so they're easier to make out; legends grew too, to stay well above their adults

changes.title: Legend share
items: Sleeping legends are rarer: about one area in five has one, not one in two
